description: The publish review as an editor meets it on @codeyam/cms 0.4.0. This screen used to lead with a raw +/- diff of markdown and YAML — code, shown to a non-technical editor at the moment she decides whether to publish. It now says what the change did in words and keeps the diff behind a disclosure for whoever wants it. Worth its own scenario because it is the screen the upgrade actually changes for Nicole, and because a summary that misdescribes an edit is worse than a diff that merely looks technical.
